packages.name: @lenso/core
notes: Published 0.1.0 exposes defineApp({ plugins }) only. PluginContext exposes get/onCleanup, and RunningApp exposes get/status/contributions/stop.
Source adds Logger, instanceId, logger, config binding/source APIs and config subpaths; these are absent from the published tarball.
Exact object identity applies to requires, context.get and running.get; duplicate IDs do not substitute dependencies.

packages.name: @lenso/engine
notes: Published 0.1.0 supports defineEngineConfig/defineEnginePlugin and explicit defineOperation.
Source adds describePluginConfig and config metadata; source operations subpath additionally exports executeOperation and safeInputSchema, absent from published 0.1.0.
App assembly is default defineApp plus named operations; there is no defineApplication export.

packages.name: @lenso/cli
notes: Version 0.1.0 is absent. Exact 0.18.0 is published and separately audited.
Published 0.18.0 is compatible with core/engine 0.1.0 for defineOperation, inspect and call; source has newer logging/config diagnostics.

packages.name: @lenso/web
notes: Published 0.1.0 uses @orpc/client/server 1.15.5, exposes root/client only and defines Router<any, WebContext>.
Source uses oRPC 2.0.0-beta.42 and Router<WebContext>, adds /bun, WebPluginOptions.errorStatusMap and telemetry.requestLifetime, plus logger/instance instrumentation.
Published createClient supports fetch and headers. React is a consumer integration through a typed client; no @lenso/web React export or hooks exist.

packages.name: @lenso/auth
notes: Published peer @orpc/server is ^1.15.5; source pins 2.0.0-beta.42. Keep adapter versions aligned.
Core Auth, Fetch, sessions, source and Drizzle entry names are published; optional peers need installation only when their entry is consumed.

packages.name: @lenso/db
notes: Published entries are root, /bun-sql, /bun-sqlite and /d1. createDrizzlePlugin preserves native Drizzle types.
No common ORM, automatic migrations or database-independent query API is supplied.

packages.name: @lenso/workers
notes: Published createWorkerHandler assembles/starts a separate app inside each incoming Fetch request.
Bindings are borrowed platform-owned resources; streamed body completion/cancellation controls app cleanup.

packages.name: @lenso/storage
notes: Published providers are /local, /s3 and /r2. Files metadata/service adapters are /files, /sqlite, /postgres and /fetch.
Only declared export entries are public; /stream is not an exported subpath even though an internal declaration file exists.
S3 optional peers are ^3.1147.0 and Drizzle is exactly 0.45.3. Signed URL capabilities vary by provider.

packages.name: @lenso/tasks
notes: Published task queue API and PostgreSQL provider exist; there is no Workers task provider.
Source adds createTaskQueue instanceId/pluginId/logger options, TaskContext logger/identity and provider traceMetadata. Published 0.1.0 has none of these telemetry fields.
Only root and /postgres are exported; internal /worker and /contracts are not exported subpaths.

packages.name: @lenso/log
notes: Entire package name returned registry 404. Source 0.1.0 implements Pino logger support, but it is not a published npm install path at audit time.

packages.name: @lenso/otel
notes: Entire package name returned registry 404. Source 0.1.0 has root/browser/bun/orpc/workers entries, but none are a published npm install path at audit time.

packages.name: @lenso/mcp
notes: Published 0.1.0 exports serveStdio only and depends on cli ^0.18.0, engine ^0.1.0 and official MCP SDK 1.32.1.
Trusted launch root/allowlist select existing declared CLI operations. No remote auth, resources, prompts, task capability or shell adapter is advertised.
One admitted business call at a time; cancellation is request-only, close drains the call; all tool calls use trusted process launch identity.
